meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: component_aTeFTuRYnwISb33RP_playbook
actions:
  Create_Enrichment_Variables:
    title: Create Enrichment Variables
    type: createVariables
    description: >
      Initializes variables to store VirusTotal enrichment provider name and enrichment result array for the workflow.
    on-success:
    - Conditional_Parallel: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Enrichment_Provider
      value: VirusTotal
    - name: Enrichment
      value: []
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    inputSchemaReferenceId: eefa3b56-7d7f-4af5-b0ea-3f1867203415
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 5fab957c-b4ad-40a0-8dd5-d76fe10d8242
  Conditional_Parallel:
    title: Conditional Parallel
    type: parallelGroup
    description: >
      Executes multiple conditional branches in parallel to handle different observable types and their reputation lookups.
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete:
    - NOOP: {}
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - IPURLDomainHash
    actions:
      IPURLDomainHash:
        title: IP/URL/Domain/Hash/File
        type: conditional
        description: >
          Evaluates if the input observable type is supported (IPv4, IPv6, domain, URL, MD5, SHA1, or SHA256) before proceeding with reputation check.
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        conditions:
        - action: Get_Observable_Reputation
          condition:
            $:or:
            - $:or:
              - - $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_type
                - $:eq: ipv4_public
                - ignoreCase: true
              - - $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_type
                - $:eq: ipv6_public
                - ignoreCase: true
              - - $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_type
                - $:eq: domain
                - ignoreCase: true
              - - $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_type
                - $:eq: url
                - ignoreCase: true
              - - $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_type
                - $:eq: md5
                - ignoreCase: true
              - - $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_type
                - $:eq: sha1
                - ignoreCase: true
              - - $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_type
                - $:eq: sha256
                - ignoreCase: true
        else: ""
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        inputSchemaReferenceId: c9819b86-cb95-4e37-ae69-9ef9b11cf061
      Get_Observable_Reputation:
        title: Get Observable Reputation
        type: connector
        description: >
          Queries VirusTotal API to retrieve reputation and analysis data for the provided observable value.
        on-success:
        - Create_TEDS_Enrichment: {}
        on-failure:
        - Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment: {}
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: virustotal.search
        inputs:
          parameters:
            query: '{ $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_value }'
        pool: $default
        testInputs:
          parameters:
            query: ""
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        environment: {}
        asset: VirusTotal
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 73ad5fa0-ad66-4e03-8101-2d3c0bca8adc
      Create_TEDS_Enrichment:
        title: Create TEDS Enrichment
        type: transformation
        description: >
          Transforms VirusTotal API response into standardized TEDS enrichment format including verdict, timestamp, permalink, context, and raw data.
        on-success:
        - Update_Enrichment_Reputation: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        transformations:
          enrichment_verdict:
            title: Enrichment Verdict
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: >-
                (

                    $last_malicious := actions.Get_Observable_Reputation.result.json_body.data.attributes.last_analysis_stats.malicious;

                    $last_malicious > 5 ? "malicious"
                    : $last_malicious > 0 ? "suspicious"
                    : $last_malicious = 0 ? "benign"
                    : "unknown"

                )
              data:
                actions:
                  Get_Observable_Reputation:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        data:
                          $:ref: $actions.Get_Observable_Reputation.result.json_body.data
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment_timestamp
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          enrichment_timestamp:
            title: Enrichment Timestamp
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: >-
                actions.Get_Observable_Reputation.result.json_body.data.attributes.last_analysis_date 

                ? $fromMillis(actions.Get_Observable_Reputation.result.json_body.data.attributes.last_analysis_date * 1000) 

                : $now()
              data:
                actions:
                  Get_Observable_Reputation:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        data:
                          $:ref: $actions.Get_Observable_Reputation.result.json_body.data
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment_permalink
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          enrichment_permalink:
            title: Enrichment Permalink
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: '"https://virustotal.com/gui/search/" & $encodeUrlComponent(inputs.observable.observable_value)'
              data:
                inputs:
                  observable:
                    observable_value:
                      $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_value
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment_context
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          enrichment_context:
            title: Enrichment Context
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: >-
                (
                    $data := actions.Get_Observable_Reputation.result.json_body.data;

                    $context := $data.**.last_analysis_stats ? "Harmless: " & $data.**.last_analysis_stats.harmless & ", Malicious: " & $data.**.last_analysis_stats.malicious & ", Suspicious: " & $data.**.last_analysis_stats.suspicious & ", Undetected: " & $data.**.last_analysis_stats.undetected
                             : "No Context Provided"
                )
              data:
                actions:
                  Get_Observable_Reputation:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        data:
                          $:ref: $actions.Get_Observable_Reputation.result.json_body.data
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          enrichment:
            title: Enrichment
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: >-
                {
                    "enrichment_type": "reputation",
                    "enrichment_provider": variables.Enrichment_Provider,
                    "enrichment_verdict": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_verdict,
                    "enrichment_timestamp": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_timestamp,
                    "enrichment_permalink": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_permalink,
                    "enrichment_context": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_context,
                    "enrichment_raw_data": actions.Get_Observable_Reputation.result.json_body
                }
              data:
                variables:
                  Enrichment_Provider:
                    $:ref: $variables.Enrichment_Provider
                actions:
                  Create_TEDS_Enrichment:
                    result:
                      enrichment_verdict:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_verdict
                      enrichment_timestamp:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_timestamp
                      enrichment_permalink:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_permalink
                      enrichment_context:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment_context
                  Get_Observable_Reputation:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        $:ref: $actions.Get_Observable_Reputation.result.json_body
            actionType: jsonata
            next: ""
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
        entrypoint: enrichment_verdict
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 82420b27-2b62-4ea5-8245-e85ff751366a
      Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment:
        title: Create TEDS Error Enrichment
        type: connector
        description: >
          Handles error scenarios from failed VirusTotal lookups by creating standardized error enrichment data with provider, status, and message.
        on-success:
        - Update_Enrichment_Error_Reputation: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: $playbook.component_aT0MBgT0PDhSCQjJu_playbook
        inputs:
          error_provider: VirusTotal
          error_result: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Observable_Reputation.error.message }'
          error_status: '{ $:ref: $actions.Get_Observable_Reputation.error.reason }'
        pool: $default
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
        testInputs: {}
      Update_Enrichment_Reputation:
        title: Update Enrichment (Reputation)
        type: updateVariables
        description: >
          Sets the Enrichment variable with the successfully retrieved and formatted reputation data from VirusTotal.
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
        - name: Enrichment
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment.result.enrichment
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 1ba28906-55f9-40df-ad5d-20f57034621b
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
      Update_Enrichment_Error_Reputation:
        title: 'Update Enrichment (Error: Reputation)'
        type: updateVariables
        description: >
          Sets the Enrichment variable with error enrichment data when the VirusTotal reputation lookup fails.
        on-success: []
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        inputs:
        - name: Enrichment
          operation:
            type: set
            value:
              $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment.result.published.enrichment
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 8255d569-975c-4480-b5b9-17b5f8e88d2b
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        pool: ""
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  NOOP:
    title: NOOP
    type: transformation
    description: >
      No-operation placeholder action that performs no processing and serves as a flow convergence point.
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    transformations: {}
    entrypoint: ""
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
meta:
  customActionInputSchema:
    Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment: {}
    Submit_File_for_Analysis: {}
    Get_File_Analysis: {}
    Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment_File: {}
    Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment_File_Upload: {}
    Build_File: {}
    normalize_BuildFile_apkib: {}
title: component_aJpxP4W3QYnQiHHKd_playbook
description: ""
namespace: $default
entrypoints:
- Create_Enrichment_Variables
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish:
  enrichment:
    $:ref: $variables.Enrichment
environment: {}
outputSchemaReferenceId: 36f8144b-d8e3-4654-ac7d-4961b80635ea
triggers: {}
inputSchemaReferenceId: 1c17f18d-81cf-4ee0-afac-0d6d54e2d589
publishSchemaReferenceId: 6a06e08d-576d-4c28-af7c-fe188c7a3dbb
